name: Undercurrent or underpower protection
summary: Recognises a current or power level below the documented minimum operating criterion.
description: Recognises a current or power level below the documented minimum operating criterion.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the measured current or power and running-state supervision. The associated drawing should trace the underload alarm or machine stopping path; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the measured current or power and running-state supervision.
Trace the underload alarm or machine stopping path.
drawingChecklist: Label the measured current or power and running-state supervision.
Cross-reference the underload alarm or machine stopping path.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: An underload reference must state its measured quantity; device 32 describes directional power rather than a generic low-current condition.
